Framed Prints

The Frame Room

This is the room where our pictures arrive finished. Our print partner prints and frames each one when you order, at 12 by 18 inches, and it comes to you ready to hang. You are buying a finished piece here, not a file. If you would rather print and frame your own, the printable sets live on Paper & Pine.

Framed & ready to hang

These are The Road Back, Blue Ridge Layers at Dawn, and Books and Candlelight. All three started as printable sets, and the files are still on Paper & Pine. We offer them finished now for anyone who would rather skip the printing and framing. More designs will join them over time. We would rather add them properly than all at once.
